_: AUTHORED BY HAND. What each document IS — its meaning, authority and warnings. No walk can know these. tools/sources.js merges this with a repo walk to write SOURCES.json.
_law: A source that cannot be reached is not a source. It is a thing somebody remembers.
_howToEdit: Add a path here when a document acquires meaning. Never edit SOURCES.json.

preamble._: THE SOURCE INDEX. Every document the book draws on, with a URL that can be fetched without a token. Read this first; walk from it to everything else.
preamble._why: The book is written in sessions that begin with nothing. No memory of the last one, no access to the repos, no continuity except what was written down. On 18 August a whole working night was spent with the author unable to read a single file — every fact arrived by hand, and the two occasions where reasoning ran ahead of a live reading both produced wrong answers. This file is the fix: one place that says where everything is.
preamble._law: A SOURCE THAT CANNOT BE REACHED IS NOT A SOURCE. It is a thing somebody remembers.
_howToRead: raw.githubusercontent.com is fetchable. github.com/<user>/<repo>/blob/... is NOT — it is a browse page and it is blocked.
Sizes are given because context is finite. Fetch deliberately: the Siege chronicle alone is 433 KB and will crowd out everything else.
Anything marked private:true needs a token. Do not put one in a chat. Ask the captain for the passage.
The registers are REGENERATED by the ship. Never quote a number from this file — fetch the register and read it at the hour of writing.

behindTheCaptain.what: The mirror. Six Workers, source and CONFIG.json. The mint and the proxy live here.
behindTheCaptain.note: Needed for eight of the twenty-one spells, which is why they read UNREACHABLE rather than CONFIRMED.

behindTheCaptain.what: The hub at amenti.live. Gate, fleet cards, the Glass Gate console.

branches._note: Fleet-Documents' default branch is literally named `branch`. It is not a placeholder. A URL built with `main` there returns 404, and that 404 looks exactly like a missing file.

traps: github.com/<user>/<repo>/blob/... is a browse page and is BLOCKED. Use raw.githubusercontent.com.
names.csv column zero is Rank. Find the name column BY HEADER.
A register read from this file is a memory. Fetch it.
The Siege is 433 KB and Page1 is 525 KB. Both will eat a session whole.
The hub's Engineering tab lists 8 of 41 briefs. Walk the repo, not the tab.
Several briefs appear twice under different names (quizzard / Amenti_The_Quizzard, the-leif / Amenti_The_Leif_Brief). Check both before citing.
Gameroom0.0 is a SIXTH repo and was on no list until 19 August. If a seventh exists, this index does not know about it either.
preamble._finding: THE HUB LINKS EIGHT BRIEFS. THE REPO HOLDS FORTY-ONE. The Engineering tab shows a subset and does not say so, and this index was built from that tab — so its first cut was missing thirty-three documents, including the SPEECH DOCTRINE and THE SACRED FRAMES, which are the two capabilities the captain names as the ones that make the site what it is. A list that shows part of a thing without saying which part is the same fault as a green lamp with nothing behind it.
